english.title: Contravene Part 2 Notice - travel measure
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been subject to a notice issued under Part 2 of the National Security Act 2023 and a travel measure imposed under paragraph 2 of Schedule 7 to the Act, and left or travelled outside the United Kingdom, contravened a measure specified in the notice in that **(..SPECIFY CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 56(1), (2), (4) and (5) of the National Security Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being subject to a notice issued under Part 2 of the National Security Act 2023
which contained a travel measure specified in that notice
left OR travelled outside of the United Kingdom and contravened a measure specified in the notice

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 56(4) increases the custodial penalty on indictment for this offence. For the offence relating to breach of a Part 2 notice containing general provisions, being subject to a lower penalty on indictment, see H101459.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or fine.
Indictment: maximum 10 years imprisonment and/or fine.
Note
The maximum penalty on summary conviction depends on the general limit in a magistrates’ court and may be 6 or 12 months depending on the date of conviction, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
